title: MIND2WEB: Towards a Generalist Agent for the Web
abstract: We introduce MIND2WEB, a dataset for developing and evaluating generalist agents for the web. The dataset contains over 2,000 tasks from 137 websites across 31 domains, enabling agents to learn and generalize across diverse environments.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine having a personal assistant that can navigate any website for you, completing complex tasks with ease. This is the vision behind MIND2WEB, a dataset designed to develop and evaluate generalist agents for the web.

With MIND2WEB, we aim to create an agent that can work on any website, handling diverse tasks and interactions.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
MIND2WEB consists of three main components: task description, action sequence, and webpage snapshots. The agent receives the task description and uses it to predict the next action, which includes the target element and operation.

We use a two-stage model, MINDACT, which first filters web elements using a small LM and then uses an LLM to predict the final action.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
We compared MIND2WEB with existing datasets and found that it offers a more comprehensive and diverse set of tasks and environments. Our results show that MINDACT achieves a decent level of generalization, with an average of 7.3 actions per task.

The benchmark results demonstrate the effectiveness of MIND2WEB in evaluating generalist agents for the web.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
MIND2WEB has the potential to make the web more accessible and usable for everyone. By developing generalist agents that can navigate and interact with any website, we can enhance the user experience and unlock new possibilities for web-based applications.

The implications of MIND2WEB are far-reaching, from improving web accessibility to enabling new forms of human-computer interaction.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
MIND2WEB introduces several key innovations, including the use of real-world websites, a broad spectrum of user interaction patterns, and a two-stage model for action prediction.

These innovations enable MIND2WEB to provide a more comprehensive and realistic evaluation of generalist agents for the web.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
We provide an open-source implementation of MIND2WEB and MINDACT, allowing researchers and developers to explore and build upon our work.

Try out MIND2WEB and see how you can contribute to the development of generalist agents for the web.
